name: Dynamic Volume Lines (DVL)
definition: A GPU-based method to visualize large-scale multi-field Adaptive Mesh Refinement (AMR) volume ensembles as 1D polylines, allowing interactive updates of alpha transfer functions and supporting non-uniform cell sizes.
summary: Dynamic Volume Lines visualizes large-scale AMR ensembles as 1D polylines to reduce clutter, distinguished by its AMR-specific importance weighting and GPU-accelerated interactive updates.
